d: Silver-grey, shoulder-length hair with a soft texture and bangs that frame a face of mature, adult appearance. The eyes are obscured by a jagged, metallic silver mask, and the build is slender and poised. The attire consists of a white high-collared blouse and a long, flowing black skirt with a tattered hem, paired with pointed black heels. Signature details include a heavy, jagged silver armor piece extending from the shoulder and head, a black rectangular tablet with white runic inscriptions held in the arm, and floating black crystalline shards surrounding the body.
